description: controls whether this plot participates in automatic movie generation. If a plot name s is not specified, the current view is assumed.

keywords.name: active
keywords.description: Turns participation in movie frame generation on and off (default off).

keywords.name: extension
keywords.description: The extension (and format) used for movie bitmap generation; one of the bare keywords bmp, cur, icns, ico, jpeg, jpg, pbm, pgm, png, ppm, tif, tiff, wbmp, webp, xbm, xpm (9.8 also accepts jfif). The install default is png.

keywords.name: index
keywords.description: The next index used for the movie frame filename; incremented per frame.

keywords.name: interval
keywords.description: Global calculation steps taken between movie frames.

keywords.name: prefix
keywords.description: The prefix used for the automatically generated frame filenames.

keywords.name: size
keywords.description: The size of the bitmap used for movie frames (install default 1024 x 768).

examples.description: Include the current plot in movie generation

notes: extension takes a bare keyword from the format enumeration; a quoted string is rejected.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (syntax grade): active, interval, index, prefix, extension and size accepted on both GUIs; quoted extension rejected with the format enumeration on both.
